214.title: Do you offer both design and development?
214.question: Can you help with both design and development?
214.answer: Yes. I can handle the product and UI/UX direction and coordinate development with the right specialists. We agree on responsibilities, scope and handover before work begins

215.title: How much does a project cost?
215.question: How do you work out the project cost?
215.answer: First we discuss the problem, the users and what success would look like. Then I recommend a realistic scope and provide a quote based on the work involved rather than guessing from a feature list

216.title: Can you improve an existing product?
216.question: Can you improve what we already have?
216.answer: Absolutely. We can review the current experience, find where customers or your team get stuck, and improve what matters without rebuilding everything unnecessarily

217.title: What do I receive at the end?
217.question: What will I receive when the project is complete?
217.answer: That depends on the agreed scope. Before starting, we document the deliverables, such as design files, prototypes, development handover or a working product, so you know exactly what to expect

218.title: How do revisions and payments work?
218.question: How do feedback, revisions and payments work?
218.answer: We agree on milestones, feedback rounds and payment terms before starting. You will know when to review the work, what is included and how any additional requests are handled

219.title: Can we work together remotely?
219.question: Can we work together from different countries?
219.answer: Yes. I work remotely with clients and keep communication clear through agreed channels, regular updates and review checkpoints that fit our time zones
